text_block_list.text:
On an afternoon with no particular plans, 
I received a message from Speed Symboli. 
"Come over," it said—

The designated location was a race café 
that was supposed to be closed today. 
Apparently, they reserved the entire venue 
for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: There you are, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ~... Wait, are you here already?

It seemed everyone had been drinking 
alcohol together. However, none of them 
appeared drunk yet.
choice_data_list: Did you only just get started?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: No, we began... around noon, was it?
choice_data_list: Wait, you've been drinking since noon?!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! We wanted a little liquid 
courage♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Since our bond has deepened so much... 
we're holding a "heart-to-heart confession 
party"♪

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thanks to that, we have been spending 
a very fruitful time together.

Despite having had drinks, all three 
maintained their usual composure without 
the slightest shift in energy. I thought 
they were just sipping slowly, but—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Look over there.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And this is only the midpoint. The idea 
came up to empty as many bottles as the 
total number of JRA victories between the 
three of us.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
They're tough, honestly. Though I don't 
intend to lose in spirit either.

Come to think of it, Speed Symboli usually 
drank mineral water. But today, she had 
liquor in her glass.
choice_data_list: Um, are you holding up alright?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Take a sip, then drink a glass of 
water. No problem at all with this method.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me. Why don't we ask 
Trainer-kun as well?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Just a moment ago, we were talking about 
how our impressions of each other have 
changed!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, Trainer-san, what 
are your impressions of us?

Haiseiko remains just as charming and cool 
as she was on TV back in the day. She is, 
through and through, "Everyone's Idol."

Speed Symboli is brilliant and energetic, 
overflowing with charm the more you get to 
know her... A "Pioneer" whom you want to 
support in so many ways—

Saint Light seemed unapproachable at 
first, but actually has an endearing side. 
Furthermore, my respect only deepens for 
her high perspective that looks far into 
the future.

They are undoubtedly legendary figures who 
defined an era... The more time I spend 
with them, the more I realize their 
greatness and charm. Therefore—
choice_data_list: I respect all of you even more now.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that from a Trainer we respect so 
much makes me so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I take my hat off to your hard 
work. You were quite nervous talking to us 
at first, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yet you carry out your duties with a 
strong sense of responsibility, and with 
your deep love and respect for horse girls 
tucked in your heart... you continue to 
grow every single day.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
As a horse girl who loves racing, I am 
truly grateful to have you as a wonderful 
companion.
choice_data_list: I don't know what to say...!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
If you had met us during our active racing 
years... the impression you hold might 
have been quite different.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I see, meeting as students would mean a 
completely different dynamic, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
I presume. We would have surely brought 
you to tears.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
True... My Trainer back then cried while 
watching my training, saying, "It's 
painful just watching you."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In that sense... I also made my Trainer 
cry during our overseas campaigns.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Which means, Saint Light-san... yours 
would be out of sympathy as well, right?
choice_data_list:
No, I feel like she'd make someone cry 
from sheer strictness...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! I agree with you completely!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
My? You seem to have gotten quite merry 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ In that case, let's liven things up 
even moore!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
To us—at our absolute cutest and coolest, 
both past and present—cheers♪

Afterwards, while continuing our pleasant 
chat with these great figures... I savored 
the sheer fortune of forming a bond with 
these three still-magnificent legends—
